"""Week 4 (day 28) config changes."""
import novamind_api as nm

# 1. Capacity Tier 1 -> Tier 2 (pre-empt overload; usage hit 45% of 200k & climbing fast)
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=2))

# 2. Dev: global $1500 (keep) ; targeted S1 $1000 (keep, steep conversion ROI) ; S2 CUT to 0
#    S2 bonus (+0.1527) PERSISTS; S2 only buys plan A anyway, can't unlock plan B via dev. Save $10.5k/wk.
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1000, development=1500))
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S1": 1000.0}))  # FULL REPLACE -> drops S2

# 3. Ads: scale S1 content $1200 -> $1500/d (49% conv, 164 leads/$1k, LTV/CAC>7x, far from mktcap).
#    Keep S2 content $150/d probe. content cheapest channel; conversion is channel-independent.
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S1": 1500.0, "S2": 150.0}}))

# Prices/tiers/quotas HELD for clean churn baseline (A=19/B=79/C=199, T2/3/4, quotas 6000/6000/20000)
# Lead promo $5 global held. No R&D, no market research, no social post (avoid viral risk).

print("\n--- verify daily spend & ads ---")
import json
print("DONE")
